summary: Frontend-only test of the new End-of-trip folding (one trip folder plus one folder per leg) on test-user-pro / Model Vessel at a 390px mobile viewport. I set up Route Planning in Mongo with TEST_Mana -> TEST_ShipCove departing 18/11/2026 09:00, event TEST_FoldTrip, and 2 planned legs (TEST_ShipCove -> TEST_Picton, TEST_Picton -> TEST_Havelock). All 6 requested scenarios PASS. TRIP 1 (3 legs): DEPART from Leaving the Dock -> ARRIVED (Arrive Mooring) -> New departure > Leave Mooring -> ARRIVED (Drop Anchor) -> New departure > Leave Berth -> ARRIVED (Arrive Berth). The levels pop-up opened at every step. End of trip was UNticked on arrivals 1 and 2 (the fold step was hidden) and PRE-TICKED on the final arrival. The final fold step read 'Group this trip's Ship's Log entries into a trip folder, with a folder for each of its 3 legs'. The toast read 'Arrival logged. The trip is grouped in the Ship's Log, with a folder per leg'. Result in the DB and the UI: 1 trip folder, folder:'passage', trip:true, open:false. Its label was 'Trip: TEST_Mana to TEST_Havelock, departure 18/11/2026 09:00 - Route Planning - TEST_FoldTrip - 3 legs'. log-folder-count read '14 logs in 3 items · Nov 18, 2026'. It holds 3 leg folders in order: 'Leg 1: TEST_Mana to TEST_ShipCove, departure 18/11/2026 09:00' (6 entries), 'Leg 2: TEST_ShipCove to TEST_Picton, departure 18/11/2026 08:12' (4), 'Leg 3: TEST_Picton to TEST_Havelock, departure 18/11/2026 08:13' (4). Every entry kept its original text, starting with its leg's 'START to DEST, departure ...'. No entries were lost: 13 non-folder entries before the final arrival and 15 after (+2 arrival entries). The older unrelated entry id 87 stayed outside the folder. Notes typed during the trip went into the right leg's folder: one typed underway on leg 1 and one typed between legs 1 and 2 went into Leg 1, one typed between legs 2 and 3 went into Leg 2, one typed underway on leg 3 went into Leg 3. The trip folder is closed by default, and its contents are hidden until log-folder-toggle is clicked. Opening the leg folders showed each leg's entries. Ungroup (log-folder-ungroup-<tripId>) removed the trip folder and the 3 Leg folders moved to the top level. The toast offered Undo, the same as Group Passage. TRIP 2 (event TEST_NoFoldTrip, 1 planned leg): End of trip was unticked on arrival 1 and pre-ticked on arrival 2. I unticked it, which hid the fold step. Arriving created no new folders, all entries stayed ungrouped and boat.legs was kept. I then added a 3rd leg with New departure and arrived with End of trip ticked. That folded all 3 legs of trip 2 into 'Trip: TEST_Mana to TEST_Nelson ... - Route Planning - TEST_NoFoldTrip - 3 legs' ('12 logs in 3 items'), so a trip whose earlier fold was skipped can still be folded later. Regression from iteration_206: the levels pop-ups (DEPART, ARRIVED, New departure) opened and were pre-filled, the interim planned-times note showed, and the START/DEST/departure log prefixes were all correct. depart, arrive and legs were reset after the fold.

design_issues.screen: Ship's Log at 390px, just after a departure or arrival
issues: Twice, a note typed within about 2s of an Interim departure was not added. I clicked the Add button with force=True and the text stayed in the input. A normal click, or clicking after the toast had gone, always worked. The most likely cause is the bottom sonner toast ('Leave Mooring: N items ticked. Underway...') sitting over the Ship's Log Add button, so the tap lands on the toast. This is probably a test artifact and not data loss. Still, consider moving toasts to the top on mobile, or giving them an offset, so they don't cover the add-item bar.
The trip label is long on mobile (5 lines at 390px). That is acceptable, but a shorter label or line-clamp would make the folder rows easier to scan.

action_items: Optional: check that sonner toasts don't cover the Ship's Log Add button on mobile (see design_issues).
Optional (carried over from iteration_206): after a final arrival with End of trip unticked, a later Leaving the Dock DEPART replaces boat.legs[trip], so those legs can no longer be folded.
critical_code_review_comments: tripFold.foldTrip: members are only top-level, non-folder entries whose id is in some leg's logs. Entries the skipper already put into a folder by hand are left where they are. Good.

tripFold.foldTrip: the trip folder id is Date.now()+10 and the leg folder ids are +11..+10+n, while the arrival entry in the same mutate uses Date.now()+1. A Ship's Log note added in the same ms window could in theory collide. This is negligible, but a uid helper would be safer.

Trip and Leg 1 labels use the planned depart_at (09:00) even though the actual DEPART was 08:08. Leg 2+ use 'now' from the interim dialog. This is consistent with the earlier design, but the trip header can show a time later than the real departure.
useLogFolders: the trip folder shows 'X logs in N items', where N = direct children (the leg folders) and X = nested logs. Correct.

Folder open/closed state is synced (stored in the log row), so opening a folder on one device opens it on the next page load. This is by design, but note it for tests: check the state before clicking a toggle.
seed_data_creation: I temporarily edited test-user-pro/model_vessel in Mongo: route_start/route_dest, weather (depart_at today, event_name, planned legs) and tank sizes, and later reduced it to 1 planned leg for trip 2. I backed up the whole doc first (/tmp/backup_pro_mv_207.json) and replaced the doc with that backup at the end. To make sure the restored state wins on sync, I set its boat_ts/sec_ts/list_ts timestamps to the restore time. After the restore, shipsLog holds just entry 87, it is not underway, and legs and weather are empty. No other user's data was touched (user_cd2a5bd996a9 was not accessed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Model Vessel of test-user-pro (cookie session_token=test_session_pro_1). IMPORTANT: boat_ts is a per-field dict (Dict[str,str]). Never set it to a string. When editing boat fields in Mongo, bump boat_ts.<field>, sec_ts.boat and updated_at to now, or the app ignores or overwrites them. Planned legs are FLAT: boat.weather.legs = [{route_start, route_dest, depart_at:'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM', finish_at}]. Nesting the times under weather leaves the interim Estimated Finish empty and blocks Leave Berth/Anchor/Mooring. The interim dialog needs navigator-why-input filled. Useful testids: depart-all-done-btn, vessel-arrived-all-done-btn (while underway), arrival-new-departure-btn, interim-departure-<berth|anchor|mooring>-btn, all-done-choice-<berth|anchor|mooring>, all-done-end-trip-checkbox, all-done-step-fold, log-folders-all-btn, log-folder-*-<id>, checklist-item-text-<id>. Use normal (non-force) clicks for add-item-submit-btn right after a departure or arrival toast.
